title: Deployment Sentinel: Rollback, incident comms, and release-note alignment for runtime-1.22
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a coordinated 'Deployment Sentinel' for the runtime-1.22 launch that ties together release-blocker gating, clear rollback runbooks (canary + full), and pre-approved incident communication templates. Outcome: reduce decision latency during incidents, ensure consistent cross-team responsibilities, and provide copy-paste comms for oncall and PMs.

rollback_plan_summary: Two-tier rollback: 1) Canary rollback: immediate traffic divert to previous canary variant when metric thresholds breach (latency p95 > 2x baseline OR error-rate > 2%). 2) Full rollback: revert to last tagged runtime image if canary rollback fails or systemic data corruption suspected. Include DB migration safety-checks, cache invalidation, and compatibility verification steps.
incident_comm_templates: Initial alert (internal): Short summary, impact (services, customers), immediate mitigation steps taken, paging list, and owner. Template includes placeholders: <time>, <root-cause-hypothesis>, <next-update-window>.
Customer-facing status update: High-level impact description, affected features, ETA for mitigation if known, recommended workarounds, support contact link. Tone: transparent, non-technical.

Post-incident update: Timeline of events, RCA summary, mitigation actions, rollback justification (if performed), and follow-up items with owners and ETA for fixes. Include link to detailed postmortem doc.
